one_liner: Fist-first tomboy who dreams of being a true princess, mixing ojousama speech with brawler slang.
personality: Kawakami Princess is loud, sunny and enormously energetic, a former 'gaki-daishou' (neighbourhood kid-boss; event titles 元ガキ大将の…) who now strives to be an elegant princess modelled on the anime 'Princess Fighter' (プリファイ) and on King Halo. Her ojousama 'desu wa' speech constantly collides with rough words like 'buttobasu' and 'buchikamasu', and her solution to most problems is guts and muscle. She is sincere and devoted, calling the trainer her prince and treating them as her destined partner.

story_arc.summary: Inspired by the anime Princess Fighter, Kawakami sets out on her 'Princess Road' to become a legendary princess, with Triple Tiara goals (Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho) plus the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, Victoria Mile and Takarazuka Kinen. Her mid-story crisis is about finding the line between being herself and being selfish (event title 見つけて！私らしさと自分勝手の境界線), with an Elizabeth-Cup setback (エリザベス女王杯の後に・らしくない). The real horse won the Oaks and Shuka Sho unbeaten, then crossed first in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup but was disqualified to 12th (general knowledge, unverified in mdb).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Kawakami_Princess; model knowledge (unverified) for real-horse results
